svg.aria-label: A gene with two EcoRI sites cut into three fragments and a vector with one site cut open, each with sticky overhangs, then the middle gene fragment ligated into the vector, with the GAATTC site restored at both joins.
svg.text: gene DNA: EcoRI cuts at G^AATTC
recombinant DNA: ligase seals the matching sticky ends

g.text: The GAATTC recognition site is restored at both joins, so the same enzyme can cut it out again.
